description: This script handles testing of 'git apply' operations involving submodules, including applying patches in index and 3-way merge modes, and utilizes shared libraries for submodule update and test utilities.

methods.name: apply_index
methods.description: Applies a patch in index mode with submodule handling, ignoring dirty submodules, and checks for expected failure conditions.

methods.name: apply_3way
methods.description: Applies a patch using 3-way merge mode with submodule considerations, ignoring dirty submodules, and failure checks.
